title: Gaida (Bulgarian bagpipe)
summary: The gaida is the bagpipe of Bulgaria. Its bag is a whole animal skin, tied off at the legs, and the long drone ends in a big curved horn that rises over the piper's shoulder. The chanter is played over the deep drone, and the notes of its mode move in narrow steps.
howToPlay: A covered hole glows; an open hole shows its dark bore. The chanter is the pipe with the finger holes.
The bag gives each time a note sounds, and the drones keep the home note.
Strike close to the beat; a repeated note is cut with a quick grace note.
rules: Seven notes of the chanter, each struck close to its beat.
The drone sounds from the first breath to the last: the notes sit on top of it.
The round ends when the last note has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: Players in the mountains keep the drone steady while the melody moves over it, often leading a dance.
credits: Tradition: the gaida; melodies written for this game
